Pricing, Terms & Turnaround

Pricing depends on the type and complexity of your project — footage selection, cuts, grading, pacing, audio, captions and more.

Custom Quotation

💳

Payment Terms

50% advance to begin  ·  50% on final completion. Larger or recurring projects can have customized terms.

⏱️

Turnaround Time

Depends on video length, amount of raw footage, complexity, number of clips, effects and revisions. The estimate is confirmed before we start.

🔁

Revisions

We revise until the video matches your requirements. Requests should be specific; completely new concepts after approval may count as a new request.
